content.comment_body: Hello, I'm using the Max/Min function block which records values. I display this in a message text, but it only shows the value (min or max), without the corresponding time. How can I also see the time when the min or max occurred? Thank you.
There isn't a built-in way to display that information directly. If you need it, you'll have to create a custom program to achieve this.
Thank you [user_name]. I need to know the time of the min/max value and display it on the [product_name] text display. Please help me if possible.
Here’s an example for you. You have two options: 1) Using reporting texts, or 2) Using the Data Log. Both options are available in the example.
Thank you very much, this is very helpful.

analysis.insight_summary: The user wants to display the timestamp associated with a min/max value from the Max/Min function block. However, the current setup only displays the value and not the time. To accomplish this, the user needs to explore programming solutions or make use of features like reporting texts or data logging, as this functionality isn't available by default.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the system to be able to show both the min/max value and the timestamp when the value was recorded, specifically displayed on the [product_name] text display.
